sources: DESIGN.md ('Express is a false-positive check: 0 SQLi, 0 crypto, 0 async'); code read by hand at the pinned commit (2026-10-07). maxSeverity low is derived, not written: every Express finding is in test/ or examples/, where DESIGN caps findings at LOW and generic secret values go to LOW. A provider-format key (which keeps its severity anywhere) appearing there would fail it on purpose, for review.

entries.why: Literal session secret in an example app. DESIGN: generic secret key value, test/example file → LOW. Anchors secret scanning of examples/
res.send() of HTML built from user data in a route handler (DESIGN XSS sink, MEDIUM start, no req.*); example file → LOW. Anchors XSS scanning of examples/
pbkdf2-password is a proper password hash (HANDOFF crypto answer key)
express.raw() is body parsing, not SQL (HANDOFF SQLi notes)
supertest .query('/') is an HTTP query string, not SQL (HANDOFF SQLi notes)
